tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Everything about one bike park in one call: its runs and their features (with clip counts), how many public clips and measured rides it has, its records (the top 3 public rides for jump height, jump length, airtime and speed, biggest first) and its newest clips, each with a link. `venue` is a name (

tools.name: search_clips
tools.description: Search public clips. Newest first by default; sort "biggest" or "smallest" with a `metric` for the biggest jumps, longest jumps, most airtime or fastest runs (ranked results list each rider of a group clip on their own, and leave out rides with no value for that metric). Filter by `venue`, `feature`

tools.name: get_clip
tools.description: One public clip by id: where and when it was filmed, the rider if named, every measurement, how it was calibrated, and for a group clip (a train of riders) each rider with their own stats and link. A clip that is private, removed or does not exist all read as not found.
